derivatives.averaging: arithmetic mean of 16 signed Jacobians, before absolute-value ranking; exact ties and zero gradients do not match
derivatives.decoder: fixed linear extension into per-bit u64 contributions; bit j contributes 2^j times its exact-bit cell. There is no paper-style vocabulary, unembedding, normalization or softmax in this graph

derivatives.true: branchwise AD convention: Equal predicate zero cotangent, Where selected-branch derivative only; mathematical derivative through equality is undefined at x=1 (reported per case)
